description: One carrier's full profile on Fitralo, with its phone, e-mail and website and where and how it carries. Use it after search_carriers, which gives no contact details: for a carrier the user picked, wants to contact or wants to know more about. To find or compare carriers, use search_carriers. One carrier a call; what it has not published is null. A carrier that is unknown or no longer listed returns an error asking for a profile_url from search_carriers. Read-only and without an account: it changes and books nothing. At most 300 calls an hour from one address, for all tools together.

carrier.description: The carrier's profile_url from search_carriers, e.g. "https://fitralo.com/c/example-transport", or only its last part, "example-transport". A company name is not looked up: search for it with search_carriers first.

language.description: The user's language as a two-letter code, when Fitralo has it: labels such as services and equipment, the profile description where it is translated, and the links to the site follow it.

name: get_carrier

about.description: The company in a few lines, in the language asked when translated.

cross_trade.description: Also carries between countries other than its home country.

quote_form.description: The profile page has a form to ask this carrier for a price.

serves.description: Countries it serves, with the regions where it serves only part of one.

title: Carrier profile
